business_definition: Sanction input record containing provider sanction action details
National Provider Identifier for sanctioned provider (10 characters)
Sanction action code indicating type of provider sanction (1 character)
Condition: provider sanction action is terminate (VALUE 'T')
Condition: provider sanction action is suspend (VALUE 'S')
Condition: provider sanction action is reinstate (VALUE 'R')
Reason description for sanction action (40 characters)
Effective date of sanction action in YYYYMMDD format (8 digits)
Reserved placeholder field used for data structure alignment, padding, or holding constant values
Notice control information group for sanction notification processing
Notice prefix identifier for sanction notification (5 characters) (VALUE 'PRVNT')
Notice suffix identifier for sanction notification (3 characters)
Notice program name for sanction notification processing (8 characters)
Termination count accumulator for sanction records (5 digits) (VALUE ZERO)
